import outputs.Setups.DobocK
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Symmetric
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Calculus
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2

open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace OracleTemplate.DobocK

open outputs.Setups.DobocK

theorem oneDim_nonpos (ψ ψ' ψ'' : ℝ → ℝ) (h1 : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ψ (ψ' t) t)
    (h2 : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ψ' (ψ'' t) t) (h0 : ψ 0 = 0) (h0' : ψ' 0 = 0)
    (hneg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ψ'' t ≤ 0) : ψ 1 ≤ 0 := by sorry

section Taylor

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

theorem line_derivs (g : E → ℝ) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g) (x d : E) :
    (∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => g (x + s • d)) ⟪gradient g (x + t • d), d⟫ t) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ⟪gradient g (x + s • d), d⟫)
      ⟪fderiv ℝ (gradient g) (x + t • d) d, d⟫ t) := by sorry

theorem taylor_lower (g : E → ℝ) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x v, c * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪fderiv ℝ (gradient g) x v, v⟫) (x y : E) :
    g x + ⟪gradient g x, y - x⟫ + c / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ g y := by sorry

theorem taylor_upper (g : E → ℝ) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x v, ⟪fderiv ℝ (gradient g) x v, v⟫ ≤ c * ‖v‖ ^ 2) (x y : E) :
    g y ≤ g x + ⟪gradient g x, y - x⟫ + c / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by sorry

theorem taylor_cubic (g : E → ℝ) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g) (L : ℝ)
    (hL : ∀ x y, ‖fderiv ℝ (gradient g) x - fderiv ℝ (gradient g) y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) (x y : E) :
    g y ≤ g x + ⟪gradient g x, y - x⟫ + 1 / 2 * ⟪fderiv ℝ (gradient g) x (y - x), y - x⟫ +
      L / 6 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 3 := by sorry

end Taylor

theorem mix_apply_eq_sum (q : Public) (hnet : Network q) (v : Stacked q.n q.dim) (i : Fin q.n) :
    mix q v i = ∑ j, q.W i j • v j := by sorry

theorem inner_mix_comm (q : Public) (hnet : Network q) (u v : Stacked q.n q.dim) :
    ⟪u, mix q v⟫ = ⟪mix q u, v⟫ := by sorry

theorem consensus_identity (q : Public) (hnet : Network q) (v : Stacked q.n q.dim) :
    ⟪v, v - mix q v⟫ = 1 / 2 * ∑ i, ∑ j, q.W i j * ‖v i - v j‖ ^ 2 := by sorry

theorem wmin_le (q : Public) (i : Fin q.n) : wmin q ≤ q.W i i := by sorry

theorem consensus_bounds (q : Public) (hnet : Network q) (v : Stacked q.n q.dim) :
    0 ≤ ⟪v, v - mix q v⟫ ∧ ⟪v, v - mix q v⟫ ≤ 2 * (1 - wmin q) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by sorry

theorem mix_add (q : Public) (u v : Stacked q.n q.dim) : mix q (u + v) = mix q u + mix q v := by sorry

theorem mix_sub (q : Public) (u v : Stacked q.n q.dim) : mix q (u - v) = mix q u - mix q v := by sorry

theorem mix_smul (q : Public) (c : ℝ) (u : Stacked q.n q.dim) : mix q (c • u) = c • mix q u := by sorry

theorem penaltyHessian_inner (p : Params) (f : Fin p.n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.dim) → ℝ)
    (x v : Stacked p.n p.dim) :
    ⟪penaltyHessian p.toPublic f x v, v⟫ =
      ∑ i, ⟪fderiv ℝ (gradient (f i)) (x i) (v i), v i⟫ + 1 / p.lam * ⟪v, v - mix p.toPublic v⟫ := by sorry

theorem penaltyHessian_bounds (p : Params) (f : Fin p.n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.dim) → ℝ)
    (hnet : Network p.toPublic) (hlam : 0 < p.lam) (hA1 : Assumption1 p.toPublic p.m p.M f)
    (x v : Stacked p.n p.dim) :
    p.m * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪penaltyHessian p.toPublic f x v, v⟫ ∧
      ⟪penaltyHessian p.toPublic f x v, v⟫ ≤ a p * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by sorry

theorem penaltyGradient_inner (p : Params) (f : Fin p.n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.dim) → ℝ)
    (x d : Stacked p.n p.dim) :
    ⟪penaltyGradient p.toPublic f x, d⟫ =
      ∑ i, ⟪gradient (f i) (x i), d i⟫ + 1 / p.lam * ⟪x - mix p.toPublic x, d⟫ := by sorry

theorem penalty_decomp (p : Params) (f : Fin p.n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.dim) → ℝ)
    (hnet : Network p.toPublic) (x y : Stacked p.n p.dim) :
    penalty p.toPublic f y - penalty p.toPublic f x - ⟪penaltyGradient p.toPublic f x, y - x⟫ =
      ∑ i, (f i (y i) - f i (x i) - ⟪gradient (f i) (x i), y i - x i⟫) +
        1 / (2 * p.lam) * ⟪y - x, (y - x) - mix p.toPublic (y - x)⟫ := by sorry

theorem penalty_quadratic_bounds (p : Params) (f : Fin p.n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.dim) → ℝ)
    (hnet : Network p.toPublic) (hlam : 0 < p.lam) (hA1 : Assumption1 p.toPublic p.m p.M f)
    (x y : Stacked p.n p.dim) :
    penalty p.toPublic f x + ⟪penaltyGradient p.toPublic f x, y - x⟫ + p.m / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤
        penalty p.toPublic f y ∧
      penalty p.toPublic f y ≤
        penalty p.toPublic f x + ⟪penaltyGradient p.toPublic f x, y - x⟫ + a p / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by sorry

theorem sum_norm_cube_le {n dim : ℕ} (d : Stacked n dim) : ∑ i, ‖d i‖ ^ 3 ≤ ‖d‖ ^ 3 := by sorry

theorem penalty_cubic_bound (p : Params) (f : Fin p.n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.dim) → ℝ)
    (hnet : Network p.toPublic) (hA1 : Assumption1 p.toPublic p.m p.M f)
    (hA2 : Assumption2 p.toPublic p.L f) (hL : 0 ≤ p.L) (x y : Stacked p.n p.dim) :
    penalty p.toPublic f y ≤ penalty p.toPublic f x + ⟪penaltyGradient p.toPublic f x, y - x⟫ +
      1 / 2 * ⟪penaltyHessian p.toPublic f x (y - x), y - x⟫ + p.L / 6 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 3 := by sorry

theorem penalty_continuous (p : Params) (f : Fin p.n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.dim) → ℝ)
    (hA1 : Assumption1 p.toPublic p.m p.M f) : Continuous (penalty p.toPublic f) := by sorry

theorem penalty_exists_minimizer (p : Params) (f : Fin p.n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.dim) → ℝ)
    (hnet : Network p.toPublic) (hlam : 0 < p.lam) (hm : 0 < p.m)
    (hA1 : Assumption1 p.toPublic p.m p.M f) :
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn (penalty p.toPublic f) Set.univ xstar := by sorry

theorem hessian_symm {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (g : E → ℝ) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g) (x u v : E) :
    ⟪fderiv ℝ (gradient g) x u, v⟫ = ⟪u, fderiv ℝ (gradient g) x v⟫ := by sorry

theorem penaltyHessian_symm (p : Params) (f : Fin p.n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.dim) → ℝ)
    (hnet : Network p.toPublic) (hA1 : Assumption1 p.toPublic p.m p.M f) (x u v : Stacked p.n p.dim) :
    ⟪penaltyHessian p.toPublic f x u, v⟫ = ⟪u, penaltyHessian p.toPublic f x v⟫ := by sorry

end OracleTemplate.DobocK
